title: 临界阻尼放电
statement: 图示电路中 U_s = 10 V，R = 10 Ω，L = 0.5 H，C = 20 mF。t < 0 时 S_1 闭合、S_2 断开，电路已达稳态；t = 0 时 S_1 断开、S_2 同时闭合，电容经 R、L 放电。
判断阻尼状态，求 t = 0.1 s 时的 u_C 和电流 i，并说明 i 何时达到最大。

questions.ask: t > 0 时的放电过程属于哪种情况？
choiceExplain: 可能漏了系数 2，拿 R 与 √(L/C) = 5 Ω 比较；串联 RLC 的临界电阻是 2√(L/C)。
可能把 C = 20 mF 当成了 20 µF，算出 2√(L/C) ≈ 316 Ω；20 mF = 0.02 F。
比较 R 与 2√(L/C) 就能判断，所需的 R、L、C 都已给出。

questions.ask: t = 0.1 s 时电流 i = ?（参考方向见图）
questions.explain: i 从电容正极板流出，i = −C·du_C/dt = U₀·α²·C·t·e^(−αt) = (U₀/L)·t·e^(−αt) = 20t·e^(−10t) A。t = 0.1 s：i = 2e⁻¹ ≈ 0.7358 A。

questions.ask: 放电电流 i 在什么时刻达到最大值？
choices: i 单调减小，没有极大值
choiceExplain: i(0₊) = i(0₋) = 0：电感电流不能跃变，放电电流从零开始增大，t = 0₊ 是最小值而不是最大值。
0.05 s = L/R = 1/(2α)，是把衰减系数算成了 α = R/L；串联 RLC 的 α = R/(2L)。
i 从 i(0₊) = 0 开始、最后又衰减到 0，中间必然有极大值；单调变化的是 u_C。
questions.explain: di/dt = 20(1 − 10t)e^(−10t) = 0 → t = 0.1 s = 1/α。所以第 2、3 问求的正好是电流的最大值 i_max = 2e⁻¹ ≈ 0.736 A。

hints: 先求 u_C(0₊) 和 i(0₊)：t < 0 时电容接在 U_s 上，电感支路没有电流。
比较 R 和 2√(L/C)；相等时特征根是重根 s = −α。
临界阻尼的通解 u_C = (A₁ + A₂t)e^(−αt)，用 u_C(0₊) 和 du_C/dt(0₊) = −i(0₊)/C 定常数。
solution: **1. 初始值。** t < 0：S_1 闭合，电容直接接在 U_s 上，u_C(0₋) = 10 V；S_2 断开，电感中无电流。换路定则：u_C(0₊) = 10 V，i(0₊) = 0。

en.title: Critically damped discharge
statement: In the circuit U_s = 10 V, R = 10 Ω, L = 0.5 H, C = 20 mF. For t < 0, S_1 is closed and S_2 open, and the circuit is in steady state; at t = 0, S_1 opens and S_2 closes at the same time, and the capacitor discharges through R and L.
Classify the damping, find u_C and the current i at t = 0.1 s, and say when i reaches its maximum.

questions.ask: Which case describes the discharge for t > 0?
choiceExplain: This probably drops the factor 2 and compares R with √(L/C) = 5 Ω; the critical resistance of a series RLC is 2√(L/C).
This probably reads C = 20 mF as 20 µF, giving 2√(L/C) ≈ 316 Ω; 20 mF is 0.02 F.
Comparing R with 2√(L/C) decides it, and R, L and C are all given.
questions.explain: 2√(L/C) = 2√(0.5/0.02) = 2 × 5 = 10 Ω = R, exactly critical damping: the characteristic root is a double root s = −α = −R/(2L) = −10 s⁻¹.
Critical damping: u_C(t) = U₀(1 + αt)e^(−αt) = 10(1 + 10t)e^(−10t) V. At t = 0.1 s: u_C = 10 × 2 × e⁻¹ ≈ 7.358 V.

questions.ask: Current i at t = 0.1 s = ? (reference direction as drawn)
questions.explain: i leaves the capacitor's + plate, so i = −C·du_C/dt = U₀·α²·C·t·e^(−αt) = (U₀/L)·t·e^(−αt) = 20t·e^(−10t) A. At t = 0.1 s: i = 2e⁻¹ ≈ 0.7358 A.

questions.ask: When does the discharge current i reach its maximum?
choices: i decreases monotonically and has no maximum
choiceExplain: i(0+) = i(0−) = 0: the inductor current cannot jump, so the discharge current starts from zero — t = 0+ is its minimum, not its maximum.
0.05 s = L/R = 1/(2α) comes from taking α = R/L; for a series RLC α = R/(2L).
i starts at i(0+) = 0 and decays back to 0, so it must have a maximum in between; it is u_C that changes monotonically.
questions.explain: di/dt = 20(1 − 10t)e^(−10t) = 0 → t = 0.1 s = 1/α. So questions 2 and 3 ask exactly for the peak current i_max = 2e⁻¹ ≈ 0.736 A.

hints: Find u_C(0+) and i(0+) first: for t < 0 the capacitor sits across U_s and the inductor branch carries no current.
Compare R with 2√(L/C); when they are equal the characteristic root is a double root s = −α.
The critically damped solution is u_C = (A₁ + A₂t)e^(−αt); fix the constants with u_C(0+) and du_C/dt(0+) = −i(0+)/C.
solution: **1. Initial values.** For t < 0 S_1 is closed and C sits directly across U_s, so u_C(0−) = 10 V; S_2 is open, so the inductor carries no current. Switching rules: u_C(0+) = 10 V, i(0+) = 0.
**2. Damping.** 2√(L/C) = 2√(0.5/0.02) = 10 Ω = R → **critically damped**. α = R/(2L) = 10 s⁻¹, double root s₁ = s₂ = −10 s⁻¹.
**5. Peak current.** di/dt = 20(1 − 10t)e^(−10t) = 0 → t_m = 1/α = **0.1 s**, i_max ≈ 0.736 A. Check: u_L(0+) = u_C(0+) = 10 V, so di/dt(0+) = u_L/L = 20 A/s, matching the slope of i(t) at t = 0.
